senses.gloss: f. (denom. of תּוּרְנָא) [wood used for masts,] pine (Löw, Pfl. 388: cypress).
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 80b:17">B. Bath. 80ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 23a:6">R. Hash. 23ᵃ</cite> (expl. <cite ref="U00732"><he>שִׁטָּה</he></cite>, <cite ref="Isaiah 41:19">Is. XLI, 19</cite>).
<cite ref="Gittin 57a:21">Gitt. 57ᵃ</cite> <he>כי הוה … שתלי ת׳</he> when a boy was born, they planted a cedar, when a girl, a pine.
